claims.claim: Kioxia and Nvidia demonstrated processing a database of 2 trillion vectors on an Nvidia GB200 NVL72 using 144 Kioxia XD8 7.68 TB E1.S NVMe SSDs.
claims.episode_span: On an Nvidia GB200 NVL72 rack-scale system, the setup processed a database of two trillion vectors using 144 Kioxia XD8 Series 7.68 TB E1.S NVMe SSDs.
claims.source_title: (PR) Kioxia and NVIDIA Collaborate to Expand Effective High-Bandwidth Memory Capacity with SSDs
claims.supporting_quote: The collaboration demonstrates the potential to process a database of 2 trillion vectors on an NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 rack-scale system equipped with 144 KIOXIA XD8 Series 7.68 TB E1.S NVMe SSDs.

claims.claim: SCADA is a software library designed to extend effective GPU memory capacity using NVMe SSDs, including fine-grained access at small block sizes.
claims.episode_span: SCADA, Scaled Accelerated Data Access, is a software library meant to extend effective GPU memory with NVMe drives, including fine-grained reads at small block sizes.
claims.source_title: (PR) Kioxia and NVIDIA Collaborate to Expand Effective High-Bandwidth Memory Capacity with SSDs
claims.supporting_quote: By combining NVIDIA SCADA (short for Scaled Accelerated Data Access, a software library designed to extend effective GPU Memory capacity using NVMe SSDs, including for fine-grained data access using small block sizes) and Storage-Next software technologies with high-performance NVMe SSDs, the collaboration demonstrates an approach to making larger datasets accessible for AI processing beyond the capacity limits of HBM alone.

claims.claim: TSMC A14 PDK 0.9 opens the 1.4nm node for design, with mass production set for 2028.
claims.episode_span: TSMC’s A14 process-design kit, PDK 0.9, is open, which puts the 1.4-nanometre node in front of chip designers rather than leaving it as a foundry roadmap line.
claims.source_title: TSMC A14 PDK 0.9 Opens the 1.4nm Node for Design, With Mass Production Set for 2028
claims.supporting_quote: TSMC A14 PDK 0.9 Opens the 1.4nm Node for Design, With Mass Production Set for 2028

claims.claim: TSMC lifted pure-play foundry share to 75 percent as the sector grew 36 percent in the third quarter.
claims.episode_span: Digitimes reports TSMC’s share of the pure-play foundry market rose to 75 percent.
claims.source_title: TSMC lifts pure-play foundry share to 75% as sector grows 36% in third quarter
claims.supporting_quote: TSMC lifts pure-play foundry share to 75% as sector grows 36% in third quarter

claims.claim: TSMC affiliate GUC reportedly landed the Tesla AI5 ASIC project, and 3nm constraints may limit the near-term ramp.
claims.episode_span: Howl.Link reports that TSMC affiliate Global Unichip has landed the Tesla AI5 ASIC project.
claims.source_title: [News] TSMC Affiliate GUC Reportedly Lands Tesla AI5 ASIC Project; 3nm Constraints May Limit Near-Term Ramp-Up
claims.supporting_quote: [News] TSMC Affiliate GUC Reportedly Lands Tesla AI5 ASIC Project; 3nm Constraints May Limit Near-Term Ramp-Up

claims.claim: A 500-megawatt data-centre project is planned outside San Diego, California, by Spanish renewable firm Ignis.
claims.episode_span: A 500-megawatt data-centre project outside San Diego, California, is announced, not under construction and not energized.
claims.source_title: 500MW data center project planned outside San Diego, California
claims.supporting_quote: 500MW data center project planned outside San Diego, California

claims.claim: Nvidia-backed Y Combinator startup Madrone, developing chiller-free data-centre cooling, secured 500,000 dollars in seed funding.
claims.episode_span: Nvidia has backed Madrone, a Y Combinator venture building a chiller-free data-centre cooling system.
claims.source_title: Nvidia backs startup developing chiller-free data center cooling system
claims.supporting_quote: Y Combinator venture Madrone secures $500k seed funding

claims.claim: Norway has frozen data-centre grid access until 2027 as demand surges.
claims.episode_span: Norway has frozen data-centre access to the grid until 2027.
claims.source_title: Norway Freezes Data Center Grid Access Until 2027 as Demand Surges
claims.supporting_quote: Norway Freezes Data Center Grid Access Until 2027 as Demand Surges

claims.claim: Electronics manufacturers are scouring eBay and brokers for DRAM and buying batches of 5 to 12 units, with some taking loans to hold cash.
claims.episode_span: Tom’s Hardware reports electronics makers have stood up memory “war rooms” in what it calls the worst DRAM shortage in history, sending staff to eBay and to hundreds of brokers and taking lots as small as five to twelve units.
claims.source_title: Electronics manufacturers set up memory 'war rooms' to find, lock in DRAM supplies amid worst shortage in history
claims.supporting_quote: The memory chip shortage is forcing companies to find supplies using non-traditional avenues, such as online listings and the gray market. Some have even taken out loans just to have enough cash to buy chips as soon as they become available.

claims.claim: Singapore deputy prime minister Gan Yong said the government is engaging local businesses over tightened US export controls and could not confirm reports that Nvidia halted server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries.
claims.episode_span: Singapore deputy prime minister Gan Yong said Friday the government is engaging local businesses on how the tighter US rules hit them.
claims.source_title: Singapore engages firms over tighter US chip export controls
claims.supporting_quote: Singapore said on Friday it was “engaging” with local businesses over tightened US export controls on Nvidia’s advanced AI chips but said it could not confirm reports that the firm had halted server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries.

claims.claim: Fitch Ratings warned Asia-Pacific data-centre investment would slow and become more selective under tighter US controls on advanced AI chips.
claims.episode_span: Fitch Ratings warned that Asia-Pacific data-centre investment would slow and become more selective under tighter US controls on advanced AI chips and access to computing power.
claims.source_title: Singapore engages firms over tighter US chip export controls
claims.supporting_quote: Analysts at Fitch Ratings warned that data centre investment across Asia-Pacific would “slow and become more selective under tighter US controls over advanced AI chips” and access to computing power.

claims.claim: TSMC says CoWoS is already in production at 5x reticle size with great yields, and it is working on 9x and 14x reticle designs.
claims.episode_span: Yahoo Finance, reporting TSMC’s account of its own packaging, says CoWoS is already in production at five times reticle size, with what TSMC calls great yields.
claims.source_title: TSMC (TSM) Is Building a Semiconductor Moat That Rivals May Struggle to Cross
claims.supporting_quote: TSMC says its CoWoS is already in production at 5x reticle size with great yields and a capability that its rivals can't currently match. The semiconductor giant is working on solutions for 9x and 14x reticle designs, as AI systems combine processors and memory in larger packages.

claims.claim: A14 risk production is due in 2027, customer activity is ahead of 2nm at a similar stage, and 2nm was 8 percent of wafer revenue in the third quarter with a negative gross-margin impact.
claims.episode_span: The same account says customer activity on the A14 process is already ahead of what TSMC saw for its 2-nanometre node at a similar stage, with risk production due in 2027.
claims.source_title: TSMC (TSM) Is Building a Semiconductor Moat That Rivals May Struggle to Cross
claims.supporting_quote: Looking further ahead, customer activity on TSMC's A14 process is already well ahead of what was seen for 2nm at a similar stage. Risk production is due in 2027 and volume production in 2028. 2nm contributed 8% of wafer revenue in Q3 but did have a negative impact on gross margin during its ramp.

claims.claim: S&P Global Ratings could lower Nvidia's credit rating over smuggling allegations, lack of CEO succession planning, and possible compromise of board independence.
claims.episode_span: S&P Global Ratings has put Nvidia on notice for a possible credit downgrade, citing smuggling allegations, a lack of CEO succession planning, and a view that board members may have compromised their independence.
claims.supporting_quote: Credit rating agency puts Nvidia on notice for possible downgrade — S&P Global Ratings says ‘board members may have compromised their independence’
